news.analysis: Nix threw touchdowns to Jaylen Waddle and Nate Adkins without turning the ball over. The Broncos quarterback didn't offer much on the ground, but he has now thrown four touchdowns and zero interceptions over his last two games. Nix gets the Panthers in Week 9.
news.contents: Bo Nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns, while rushing three times for four yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.

news.analysis: Mitchell didn't see many opportunities on Sunday. He touched the ball just four times and was only able to turn that into six yards, which left him with an extremely poor fantasy total. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward.

news.title: Keaton Mitchell uninvolved in loss Sunday

news.analysis: Downs was the only Colts player to get into the end zone Sunday, scoring his first touchdown of the season on a six-yard pass from Daniel Jones late in the third quarter. Overall, Downs has mostly been a disappointment for fantasy managers this season. He has caught four or fewer passes in each of the last five games without reaching 50 yards in any of them.
news.contents: Josh Downs caught 4-of-5 targets for 23 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.title: Josh Downs finds the end zone in Week 8 loss

news.contents: Having already traded away two team captains, the 2-6 Indianapolis Colts are essentially looking at a cultural reset, and NFL Insider Adam Schefter believes that wide receiver Josh Downs could be one of the next players on the move ahead of the NFL's November 10 trade deadline. Schefter reports that the Colts have asked for a third-round pick for the fourth-year receiver but could settle for a fourth-rounder before the deadline. news.title: Josh Downs Could Be Moved for Third or Fourth-Round Pick

news.analysis: Mitchell turned in a career performance just one week after being blanked on the stat sheet. The 24-year-old found the end zone on a 12-yard reception in the second quarter and logged a team long 47-yard reception in the fourth quarter. Mitchell and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.
news.contents: Adonai Mitchell caught 7-of-9 targets for 142 yards and a touchdown in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
news.title: Adonai Mitchell finds the end zone in Week 8

news.contents: New York Jets wide receiver Adonai Mitchell is likely going to be a popular waiver-wire option after his breakout performance this past weekend. Mitchell torched the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 8, when he hauled in seven of his nine targets for 142 yards and a touchdown in the loss. The 24-year-old was looking good through the first two games of the season, but he was forced to miss four straight contests due to injury. Now, Mitchell is healthy and looks like he's going to be a relevant ...
news.title: Adonai Mitchell has Stash Value After Breakout Performance

news.analysis: Dotson had a 76-yard reception with the Falcons recording 224 total yards of offense as a team. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.title: Jahan Dotson hauls in 76 yard pass Sunday

news.analysis: After missing each of the last two games due to a groin injury, Warren was back on the field for the Colts in Week 8. It didn't make much of a difference, however, as the second-year TE struggled in what was a terrible performance from the Colts on the whole. Warren's production should improve from here, but the Colts' offense is a difficult one to trust.
news.contents: Tyler Warren managed to catch just 4-of-10 targets for only 18 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.title: Tyler Warren struggles in return from injury

news.analysis: Ward fumbled twice, losing one, but he surprisingly kept his team in it against a tough Bengals offense. The second-year quarterback completed his touchdown passes to Chimere Dike and Wan'Dale Robinson in the contest. Ward has now thrown for 1,483 yards, six touchdowns, and five interceptions through eight games. He will be on a bye in Week 9.
news.contents: Cam Ward completed 26 of his 40 passes for 304 yards and two touchdowns while adding 41 rushing yards on seven rushes in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.title: Cam Ward throws two TDs in Week 8 loss

news.analysis: With trade rumors swirling around him, Thomas was certainly still part of the plan for the Jaguars on Sunday. He hauled in his second touchdown of the campaign, scoring from 12 yards out on the team's opening drive. Thomas only saw two targets on the day, but no Jaguars player received more than three. He's still not a player to throw right back into fantasy lineups, but Thomas should be kept on the radar.
news.contents: Brian Thomas Jr. caught 1-of-2 targets for a 12-yard touchdown in Sunday's 42-7 rout of the Colts.
news.title: Brian Thomas Jr. finds the end zone in Week 8 win

news.contents: Jacksonville Jaguars wide receiver Brian Thomas Jr. has been a popular name in trade discussions as of late. Recent reports are saying there is a lot of trade interest for Thomas ahead of the upcoming trade deadline. The 24-year-old has been a non-factor in this offense throughout most of the season. He is off to a better start in 2026, gaining 142 receiving yards on nine receptions thus far, but this does not make him a worthy waiver-wire addition. Receiver Malik Benson is also a healthy scratch with Jack Bech returning from Injured Reserve this weekend. news.analysis: Helm led the Titans in targets and receiving yards with Carnell Tate sidelined by a shoulder injury. The veteran tight end has drawn 13 targets over his past two games as he is starting to carve out a larger role in the Tennessee passing game. He will be on bye in Week 9.
news.contents: Gunnar Helm caught five of his nine targets for 76 yards in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.title: Gunnar Helm goes for 76 yards in Week 8 OT loss

news.contents: Tennessee Titans tight end Gunnar Helm hauled in five of nine targets for 76 yards in the team's 43-36 overtime loss to the hosting Cincinnati Bengals. Helm led the team in receiving yards on Sunday and set career highs with his yardage and target total. In fact, the former Texas Longhorn fell just three yards shy of matching his receiving total for the season in this game alone. It was a nice effort on a day that the team was short a receiving option in wideout Carnell Tate (shoulder). ...

news.contents: Arizona Cardinals rookie first-round running back Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is headed to injured reserve after suffering a high-ankle sprain that is expected to sideline him for four to five weeks, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. The first-round rookie suffered the injury during the first quarter of Sunday's 33-30 overtime victory over the Dallas Cowboys, finishing with 23 rushing yards on nine carries.
